name: Sakegawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Sakegawa village emblem in white: a stylised letter S of curved strokes forming a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Sakegawa, a village in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 February 1967.

features.role: Sakegawa village emblem — a stylised letter S of curved strokes forming a ring
